content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"registered user with a personal task list","i_want":"to edit the title, description, priority and Due Date of an existing task","so_that":"my task details stay accurate and I can change plans without creating a new task","business_description":"Users can update an existing task through the same form used to create tasks, pre-filled with the stored values. The backend validates each change with the same rules as creation and stores the change only when valid. The frontend shows success only after the backend confirms the update. Updating the status is outside this story and is covered by the mark-as-Completed story.","business_value":"Keeps task data correct over time, which the task list and the report depend on. Using the create form for edits reduces the work needed to maintain it.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task with a valid title, a description, a priority and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"The user opens the edit form, changes the title to another non-empty value of 100 characters or fewer, and submits the form","then":"The backend stores the new title, sets the Last Updated Date to the time of the update, and the task list shows the new title only after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task with a valid title, description, priority and Due Date","when":"The user changes the description, the priority (to Low, Medium or High) and the Due Date (to a date not earlier than the Creation Date) and submits the form","then":"The backend stores each changed value and the frontend shows a success message only after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update with a missing mandatory field error, the stored title keeps its previous value, and the form shows the error message 'Title is mandatory'"},{"given":"An existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"The user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and the frontend shows an error message and no success message"},{"given":"An existing task with a title of 100 characters","when":"The user changes the title to 101 characters and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and the form shows an error message stating that the title must be 100 characters or fewer"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns an error response","when":"The frontend receives the error response","then":"The task list still shows the previous values for that task, the form does not show the task as updated, and the frontend displays an error message and no success message"},{"given":"An update request has been sent for an existing task and the backend has not yet responded","when":"The edit form is waiting for the response","then":"The task list still shows the previous values for that task and no success message is shown"},{"given":"A task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"An update request is sent for that ID","then":"The backend returns a Task Not Found error, no data is changed, and the frontend shows an error message and no success state"},{"given":"An existing task with a Last Updated Date of 2024-05-10 10:00:00 UTC","when":"An update request for that task is rejected by validation","then":"The Last Updated Date remains 2024-05-10 10:00:00 UTC and the frontend shows an error message"},{"given":"An existing task and an update request with a Priority value outside Low, Medium and High, for example Urgent","when":"The backend validates the request","then":"The backend returns an invalid input error, the stored task is unchanged, and the frontend shows an error message"},{"given":"An existing task and an update request whose database write fails on the backend","when":"The backend writes the update to the database and the write fails","then":"The backend returns an internal server error, the stored task keeps its previous values including the Last Updated Date, and the frontend shows an error message instead of a success message"}],"edge_cases":["Title made of spaces only: the PRD says the title must be non-empty but does not say whether whitespace counts as content. Open question for the team.","Title of exactly 100 characters is accepted; 101 characters is rejected.","Due Date equal to the Creation Date is accepted, because the rule only forbids an earlier date.","Changing the Due Date to a value earlier than the Creation Date is rejected, and the stored Due Date stays unchanged.","An update that fails validation or is rejected must not change the Last Updated Date.","An update request for a task that does not exist returns Task Not Found and changes no data.","A request with a Priority outside Low, Medium and High is rejected as invalid input.","The backend does not respond within the time the form waits: the form keeps the previous values and shows no success message. The PRD does not define a timeout, so this is an open question.","A database write failure returns an internal server error and leaves all stored values unchanged."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-list"],"definition_of_done":["PUT /tasks/{id} stores changed title, description, priority and Due Date and sets Last Updated Date on success.","Validation rules match those used for task creation: non-empty title, title of 100 characters or fewer, Due Date not earlier than Creation Date, Priority in Low, Medium, High.","Every rejection returns the error type defined for it: Task Not Found, invalid input, missing mandatory field, validation error or internal server error.","The edit form is pre-filled with the stored values and submits to PUT /tasks/{id}.","The UI shows a success message only after a success response and never shows a success state for a failed or pending request.","The task list shows updated values only after a success response.","Automated tests cover every acceptance criterion and pass."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add PUT /tasks/{id} endpoint that updates title, description, priority and Due Date","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Implement the success path of PUT /tasks/{id}. Apply the changed title, description, priority and Due Date to the stored task, set Last Updated Date to the time of the update, and return the updated task. Validation rejections and error responses are handled in BE-task-update-error-handling, not here.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-244669c0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["PUT /tasks/{id} updates title, description, priority and Due Date for a valid request.","Last Updated Date is set to the time of the successful update.","A successful update returns the updated task.","Error mapping is not implemented in this task and is delegated to BE-task-update-error-handling."]},{"key_slug":"task-update-error-handling","title":"[BE] Return not-found, validation, missing-field and server errors for PUT /tasks/{id}","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Own all error handling for PUT /tasks/{id}. Reuse the create validation rules: non-empty title, title of 100 characters or fewer, Due Date not earlier than Creation Date, and Priority in Low, Medium, High. Return Task Not Found for unknown IDs, invalid input for bad values, missing mandatory field for an empty title, validation error for rule violations, and internal server error for database failures. Rejected requests must not change any stored value or the Last Updated Date.","size":"S","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-9dc414dc","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-0b1853d6"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Unknown task ID returns Task Not Found and changes no data.","Empty title returns a missing mandatory field error with the message 'Title is mandatory'.","Title longer than 100 characters returns a validation error.","Due Date earlier than Creation Date returns a validation error.","Invalid Priority returns an invalid input error.","Database write failure returns an internal server error.","Rejected requests leave stored values and Last Updated Date unchanged."]},{"key_slug":"task-edit-form","title":"[FE] Open the task form in edit mode with existing values pre-filled","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Reuse the task form to edit an existing task. Pre-fill title, description, priority and Due Date from the stored task. Submit changes to PUT /tasks/{id}. Apply the same client-side checks as create (non-empty title, 100-character limit, Due Date not earlier than Creation Date) and show the backend error text when the backend rejects the request.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-9b30a145","R-bc3213df","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-0b1853d6"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Edit mode shows the stored title, description, priority and Due Date.","Submitting sends the changed fields to PUT /tasks/{id}.","Empty title shows 'Title is mandatory' in the form.","Title over 100 characters shows a message stating that the title must be 100 characters or fewer.","Due Date earlier than Creation Date shows an error message in the form.","The form does not show success while the request is pending."]},{"key_slug":"task-update-result-feedback","title":"[FE] Show success or error after task update without optimistic changes","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"After a task update, show a success message only when the backend returns success and an error message otherwise. Update the task list only after success. Do not apply changes before the response arrives, and do not show success for a Task Not Found response.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-d57336f7"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Success message appears only after a success response from PUT /tasks/{id}.","Error message appears for every error response, including Task Not Found.","No success state is shown while the request is pending or after a failed request.","The task list shows the previous values when the update fails."]},{"key_slug":"task-update-test-suite","title":"[QA] Add test suite for editing an existing task across API and form","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Test suite for the task update story covering the PUT endpoint, its validation and errors, the edit form and the result messages. Each acceptance criterion has at least one automated test.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-9b30a145","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-d57336f7","R-9dc414dc","R-0b1853d6"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["API tests cover success, Task Not Found, invalid Priority, empty title, 101-character title, Due Date earlier than Creation Date, and database failure.","Tests confirm that rejected updates leave stored values and Last Updated Date unchanged.","Form tests cover pre-fill, the 'Title is mandatory' message, the 100-character message and the success and error messages.","Tests confirm that no success state is shown while the request is pending or after an error."]}]}
